reasons.correctness: Port, properties, adapter and service match the interface. PLN returns 1 and ISO matching ignores case. HALF_UP scale 2 is applied, and the BusinessRuleTranslatableException carries the key with isoCode. Hidden tests pass 4/4.
reasons.convention_fit: CurrencyConversionService imports FixedExchangeRateAdapter, which breaks the rule that services never depend on an adapter class. i18n keys are in both en and pl. Injection is by constructor. The agent read no existing adapter or TranslatableException example.
reasons.design_fit: The port/adapter split is clean and the service holds only the port field. The unused adapter import still couples the service source to one vendor. Properties live in the adapter package. Footprint is minimal.
reasons.test_quality: The MockitoExtension test covers the rounding happy path, the missing-rate key and adapter case-insensitivity/PLN. It does not assert the isoCode argument on the exception. The run command used -Dtest=X, so the targeted run is unclear.
reasons.graph_use: One trivial query (MATCH (e:Entity) RETURN e.file_path LIMIT 1) found nothing relevant. Navigation came from reading CompanyRegistryPort. The graph did not locate the feature package, dependents or an adapter example.
